title: A flat map surjective on spectra is faithfully flat
statement: Let $R\to S$ be a flat ring map [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. If the induced map $\operatorname{Spec}S\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ is surjective, then $R\to S$ is faithfully flat [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map].

mathlib_searches.query: flat ring homomorphism is faithfully flat iff Spec map is surjective
mathlib_searches.results: RingHom.FaithfullyFlat and Module.FaithfullyFlat; no spectrum characterization found

mathlib_searches.query: RingHom.Flat plus surjective spectrum implies RingHom.FaithfullyFlat
mathlib_searches.results: Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_flat_of_nonzero_fiber and RingHom.FaithfullyFlat, but no Spec theorem
no theorem connecting spectrum surjectivity to faithful flatness
